note: Reel 34: You're the Victim (working title). Draft 3, after two cold reads: no replay and no study on screen (the study goes to the caption and the pinned comment). Three men bump you in a market lane and your wallet's gone; whoever you pick goes to jail. Look down: it slipped out of your hand at four seconds and has lain at your feet the whole time. The narrator is the series voice (af_heart). Lines that need a real pause are their own lines. Facts: docs/research.md.
ref_text: The night was cold and very quiet. Most of the street was asleep, and the lamps hummed over the empty road. Somewhere far away, a train rolled past, and then the silence came back.

lines.text: Whoever you pick goes to jail.
It's been there the whole time.
And whoever you picked is going to jail for bumping into you.
It slipped out of your hand four seconds in, while you were face to face with number two.
